observed_basis: First healthcare pair required92.75seconds; exact reuse is necessary to estimate whole-matrix CPU cost honestly
shared_initial: B1/B2/B3/P use identical grounded evidence, shared plan, model, prompt, greedy settings and seed. Compute/store one initial pair and attach the same immutable output to all four logical conditions. If any signature differs, do not reuse.
interpretation: Primary PversusB1 isolates checking/feedback repair versus blind rewrite from the same initial pair. Initial-plan superiority is not inferred from this comparison.
standalone_condition_cost: Charge the common initial cost to each logical condition for per-condition comparisons. Report physical shared whole-matrix runtime separately. Do not claim Pcost savings from cross-condition reuse.
NLI_cache: Cache exact premise/hypothesis token-ID pairs plus frozen model/revision/dtype. No semantic normalization or approximate matching; reused scores do not replace case/provenance structural checks. Same scores reused for NLI-only ablation.
target_queries: No target prediction cache; every omission and selected-result consistency recheck remains a fresh full query
required_cost_verification: Count exact NLI cache keys and token lengths on feasibility-based cost fixtures; no semantic correctness labels or benchmark performance claims
